hero.title: Your household, on your own hardware
hero.subtitle: Alfheim is a local-first household OS that runs your pantry, shopping lists, budget, chores and more on a server in your own home.

leanCore.title: Start small, add what you need
leanCore.subtitle: A default install is the Lean Core: six services that always run. Every app beyond them is an optional module you switch on when you want it.
leanCore.optionalDesc: Pantry, shopping, budget, chores, library, workout, maintenance, chat and the telemetry stack. Turning a module off keeps its data, so you can bring it back later.

fullTelemetry.name: Full + telemetry
fullTelemetry.runs: Every app plus the telemetry stack

leanCore.source: These figures summarise the self-hosting guide, which is the source of truth.

modules.title: Core and optional modules
modules.subtitle: Every module serves its pages under its own path and its API under https://<your-domain>/api/v1/<app>, on the domain you install Alfheim on.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The home screen: launcher, app catalog with live health, and personal links.

household.name: Household
household.description: Households, members, roles and invites. Every other app asks it who belongs where.

pantry.name: Pantry
pantry.description: Stock tracking, expiry alerts and barcode lookup for what is in your cupboards.

shopping.name: Shopping
shopping.description: Shared household lists and private lists, with items taken from pantry stock.

budget.name: Budget
budget.description: Accounts, savings pots, monthly plans and a transaction ledger with receipts.

chores.name: Chores
chores.description: Recurring chores, assignments, streaks and points for the whole household.

library.name: Library
library.description: A catalog of books, games and media, with loans and metadata lookup.

workout.name: Workout
workout.description: Exercise catalog, routine planner, session logging and progress analytics.

maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Home equipment, recurring maintenance schedules, checklists and repair history.

chat.name: Chat with ALFI
chat.description: ALFI, the household assistant: any LLM provider, with tools that act on your other apps.

telemetry.name: Telemetry
telemetry.description: Metrics, logs and Grafana dashboards for the server itself. Off by default.

integrations.title: Connect the services you already run
integrations.subtitle: Alfheim keeps two kinds of integration apart: links that only open another app, and plugins that talk to it.

launchers.title: App launchers
launchers.description: Household-managed tiles that open Home Assistant, Jellyfin, YouTube or any other address in a new tab. They are links only: Alfheim never calls the target and stores no secret for it.
launchers.today: Today the operator can already add such links for everyone in deploy/stack-apps.yaml.

plugins.title: Typed plugins
plugins.description: Integrations in the dashboard backend with their own settings, encrypted household credentials, a health check and an on/off switch. They only reach hosts the operator allows.

homeAssistant.name: Home Assistant
homeAssistant.description: Read and control your smart home, from the dashboard and through ALFI.

media.name: Jellyfin and Navidrome
media.description: Connect your media servers for films, series and music.

llm.name: ALFI LLM provider
llm.description: Choose which language model ALFI uses for the household.

roadmap.title: What comes next
roadmap.subtitle: Each release is planned as a GitHub milestone with its issues.

v060.title: Integrations and stability
v060.theme: CI and installer hardening, this site, household app launchers, typed plugins for Home Assistant, Jellyfin, Navidrome and ALFI's LLM provider, and native-ready API contracts (OpenAPI, PKCE).

v070.title: Native Apple client
v070.theme: A SwiftUI app for iPad and iPhone, limited to what the browser cannot do: MusicKit and AirPlay, widgets, Siri and an offline cache.
